brief.summary: Equity futures were slightly higher, with S&P and Nasdaq up about 0.3-0.4%. Front-end yields were flat near 4.73%, while long-end yields edged lower; credit concessions widened and oil rose on Middle East risk. The Fed is widely expected to hold this week, but the show's guests see a December hike and potentially more in early 2027. The dominant narrative is massive AI-related equity and debt financing, with Meta, SpaceX and Entropic deals driving both excitement and bubble concern. Tone was cautiously risk-on, tempered by Iran escalation, midterm uncertainty and consumer weakness.
notable_quotes: Only people making money from AI are AI.
